in_marathi.name: Md
in_marathi.long_meaning: Md हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Md can be translated as 'Mahadeva' or 'God's Name'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is often associated with the god Shiva.
